draft_en.subject: The 5-port switch in your engineering kits - two options and a price per kit run
draft_en.body:
Hi Justin,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 8 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the 5-port switch bundled with your engineering kits, two options, neutral or under your label from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS: desktop 5 x Gigabit unmanaged - model STC-05GE - $6.2 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); DIN-rail industrial 5 x Gigabit, 12-36 V DC, -40 to 75 C - STI-050GE - $17.8 (wide 12-58 V input version $25).

One question: what quantity per kit run do you plan - that sets the carton and the price break?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
